subject: How to create a array/vector/matrix with number of dimensions unknown at declaration time.

messages.author: 9466f38039d48e25
messages.subject: How to create a array/vector/matrix with number of dimensions unknown at declaration time.
parts:
I'm having issues in a transformed data block with arrays and vectors whose size can only be determined after inspecting some of the data.

This code won't work, because two of the variables aren't defined at the beginning of the block:

int N_gap_updates;
N_gap_updates = sum(gap_lengths);
int gap_techs[N_gap_updates];
int gap_ts[N_gap_updates];

This code won't work, because the array variables will think N_gap_updates == 0:

int N_gap_updates;
N_gap_updates = sum(gap_lengths);
int gap_techs[N_gap_updates];
int gap_ts[N_gap_updates];

What to do?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] How to create a array/vector/matrix with number of dimensions unknown at declaration time.
parts:
We'll have compound define and declare soon, which wi solve the problem. For now, a little code duplication will work. 

int N_gap_updates;
int gap_techs[sum(gap_lengths)];
int gap_ts[sum(gap_lengths)];
N_gap_updates = sum(gap_lengths);

If you think that's gonna be massively wasteful, it isn't going to be a problem in practice. 


Daniel
